projects.title: Distributed Airline Reservation System
projects.description: Built a Scala, Java and SQL based multi-tiered reservation system, implementing two-phase commit protocol as part of the Distributed Operating Systems Principles course

projects.title: Simulations of a 2-D Ising model & 2-D Lennard-Jones model
projects.description:
Generated a Markov chain of states for a 2D Ising model by developing functions in Python to return the magnetization of the state by calculating interaction energy of a single spin with the neighboring spins using the Lennard Jones model.
Investigated the phase transition in more detail by working at a single value of the coupling constant of 0.5, which is within the two-phase region (Gas-liquid system). 
Studied the fluctuations in magnetization both near the critical temperature and in the magnetized state to reduce the computational cost.
Performed Monte-Carlo simulations of the internal energy and pressure over a range of density and temperature. Simulation consisted of 10^6 MC steps & the data was broken down into blocks of 10,000 steps to determine the mean and confidence limits.
